messages:
sara: Quick follow-up — RED-8001 postmortem actions still show 2 items past due (owner missing + alert tuning). Can owners or a reasignee confirm status today? This PM flagged a recurring connection-throttle pattern.

ben: Assigned RED-8001a (owner missing) to myself to document runbook and ownership. Will update ticket within the hour.

thom: I'm on RED-8001b (alert tuning). Had a draft but blocked on access to metric stream. Filed INC-5890.

sre-bot: Reminder: RED-8001b due 2026-05-02, assigned to thom. RED-8001a due 2026-05-01, assigned to ben.

sara: If either of you can't finish today please set ticket to "Needs Reassign" and ping me. We want to avoid stale PM actions — it's been flagged as a repeat.

ben: Runbook section created: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/conn-throttle (section "postmortem ownership"). Updated RED-8001a with link and owner.

infra: INC-5890 permission request approved; change id 2026-05-01T10:22Z. Metric stream read access granted to thom.

thom: Thanks. Pulled metrics and adjusted alert thresholds. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/9401. Added an alert at 75% pool utilization and a 10m cooldown to prevent alert storms.

sara: Two asks before I close the cluster: 1) paste commit hash and PR link in ticket; 2) add a one-line verification step (e.g., "no connection errors for 48h at 95th percentile traffic").

ben: Noted. PR merged for runbook edits: commit c2f7a9d. Linked in RED-8001a.

thom: PR merged for alert tuning: commit 9a8d6b4. Added verification step in RED-8001b and set status to "Ready for Verify".

sre-bot: Scheduling automated verification: will check error rates for a 48h window and post results.

sara: Also, please add infra change log entries for any quota/permission changes so capacity reviews can see the drift. If we changed any defaults, include rationale.

infra: Logged permission change INC-5890 with rationale: temporary metric access for alert tuning, will review in next capacity meeting.

sre-bot: Verification result: no new connection errors in 48h window. RED-8001 cluster marked VERIFIED.

sara: Great, thank you. I'll close the PM follow-ups in the tracker and add a note that we've created an early-warning alert and included the change in the infra log. If anything reappears, open RED-8050 (recurrence runbook) and ping me.

ben: Filed RED-8050 for recurrence playbook and linked to the PM.

thom: One small learning: set metric access early in the PM run so alert tuning isn't blocked. Noted in RED-8001b.

sara: Closing the cluster now. If SRE finds anything during the next fortnightly sweep, reopen. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-up cluster for RED-8001 marked CLOSED by sara.

ben: Thanks everyone.

thom: Closing my side.
